name: Market Type 8 Code
definition: Specifies the type of place where a trade was executed, a price was sourced from, an instrument is listed.

COUN.name: Counter
COUN.definition: Specified type of market is counter market.

INBA.name: Inter Bank
INBA.definition: Specified type of market is inter bank market.

OTCO.name: Over The Counter
OTCO.definition: The place is over the counter.

PRIM.name: Primary Market
PRIM.definition: The place is a primary market.

SECM.name: Secondary Market
SECM.definition: The place is a secondary market.

EXCH.name: Stock Exchange
EXCH.definition: The place is a stock exchange.
